reasoning: BK virus is a polyomavirus that primarily affects immunocompromised patients, particularly transplant recipients. As of my knowledge cutoff, no licensed vaccine for BK virus exists, though research is ongoing. Given the relatively small patient population and lower commercial incentive compared to other vaccines, combined with the short timeframe (less than 1 year), vaccine development and approval by November 2025 is unlikely. Regulatory approval typically requires years of clinical trials.
